spans.s:
(उ) तनु r. 8th cl. (तनोति-तनुते)
To expand, to spread, to extend, to diffuse, to dilate, &c. physically or morally.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (तनति तानयति)
1 To confide, to believe or have faith in.
2 To aid, to assist.
3 To be harmless.
4 To sound.
5 To pain or afflict with disease.
6 (With a preposition,) To lengthen, to stretch, to expand, &c. as in the 8th cl.

m. (-नः)
A tune.
n. (-नं)
1 Expanse, extension.
2 An object of sense.
E.
तन to extend, affix घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 A son.
2 A male descendant.
f. (-या)
1 A daughter.
2 A plant: see चक्रकुल्या.
E.
तन to spread, (to extend the family or name,) कयन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
1 Smaller, less.
2 Minute, delicate, small.
E.
तनु, and इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Smallest, least.
2 Very small or delicate, &c.
E.
तुनु, and ईयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः or न्वी or नूः-नु)
1 Small, minute.
2 Delicate, fine, but with interstices.
3 Thin, slender, emaciated.
4 Little.
f. (-नुः-नूः)
1 The body.
2 The skin.
f. (नुः)
1 A woman.
2 Point of conjunction, or sun's entrance into a new sign.
f. (-न्वी)
1 A delicate or slender woman.
2 A stanza of four lines, and twenty-four syllables in each: a variety of the Saṃkṛti metre.
E.
तन to stretch or spread, Uṇādi affix उ; also तनू and तनुस्.

f. (-नूः)
The body.
E.
तन to stretch, affix ऊः see तनु.

m. (-पः)
A pore of the skin.
E.
तनु, and कूप a well.

mfn. (-छत्)
Covering (the body,) clothing, protecting.
f. (-छत्)
1

Armour.
2

Attire.
E.
तनु, and छद to cover, affix क्विप्.

m. (-जः)
A son.
f. (-जा)
A daughter.
E.
तनु body, and ज born.

m. (-जः)
A son.
f. (-जा)
A daughter.
E.
तनू, and ज born.

n. (-त्रं)
Armour, mail.
E.
तनु the body, and त्र what preserves; also तनुत्राण (-णं.)

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Armed, defended.
E.
तनुत्र, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Niggardly, sparing, letting little go or be spent.
m. (-गः)
Quitting the body, death.
E.
तवु little or the body, त्याग parting with.

f. (-स्त्रा)
The nose.
E.
तनु the body, and भस्वा a bellows.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Embodied, corporeal.
E.
तनु, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ध्या)
1 A woman with a slender or elegant waist.
2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre.
E.
तनु, and मध्य middle.

m. (-सः)
Perspiration, sweat.
E.
तनु the body, and रस juice.

n. (-हं)
The hair or down of the body.
E.
तनु, and रुह what grows: also with the final consonant. तनुरुह् n. (-रुट्)

mn. (-हः-हं)
1 The hair of the body.
2 The wing of a bird.
m. (-हः)
A son.
E.
तनु or तनू the body, and रुह what grows or rises, from रुह with क affix; also तनुरुह.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Spread, expanded.
E.
तनु to spread, उलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-तः)
A division of hell.
E.
तनु thin, small, and वात wind.

n. (-रं)
Armour.
E.
तनु, वृ to defend, अण् aff.

m. (-सः)
A warrior, a man in armour.
E.
तनुवार, and भस who shines.

m. (-णः)
A pimple, a pustule, a boil.
E.
तनु slight, and व्रण a sore.

n. (-नुः)
The body.
E.
तन to stretch, Uṇādi affix उसि.

f. (-णी)
A young woman, a girl, one of ten years old.
E.
तनु the body, सञ्चारिणी who makes perfect.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pared, made delicate or thin.
E.
तनु thin, कृत made, and उ rendered long.

m. (-निः)
A son.
E.
तनू, and जनि birth.

m. (-नः)
the wind.
E.
तनु body, ऊन defective.

n. (-पं)
Clarified butter or ghee.
E.
तनु the body, and ऊन deficiency, thinness, spareness of body, and प what cherishes; what fattens.

m. (-पाद् or पात्)
Fire or its deity.
E.
तनूनप ghee, and अद् who eats, from अद with विच् affix, or तनू the body, न negative, and पा to preserve, deriv. irr. destroying other bodies, or consuming its own support or fuel, and ceasing to be.

m. (-दः)
The anus, the rectum.
E.
तनू the body, and ह्रद a deep place.

m. (-न्तिः)
A weaver.
f. (-न्तिः)
Expansion, extension.
E.
तन to stretch, affix क्तिच्.

m. (-न्तुः)
1 A thread.
2 A shark.
3 Offspring, race, descendants.
E.
तन to spread or stretch, Uṇādi affix तुन्.

m. (-कः)
Mustard seed.
f. (-की)
A vein or any tubular vessel: see तन्तुभ.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A piece of fibrous wood, or a brush used by weavers for cleaning the threads of the woof.
E.
तन्तु a weaver's thread, and काष्ठ a woof.

m. (-टः)
A silk worm.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and कीट a worm.

m. (-णः)
A shark.
E.
तन to spread, तुण aff.

m. (-गः)
A shark.
E.
तन्तु, and नाग a snake.

m. (-सः)
A palmyra tree.
E.
तन्तु thread, and निर्यास exudation, alluding to its stringy or adhesive nature.

n. (-र्व्व)
The full moon of Śrāvaṇa, when KṚṢṆA is invested with the Brahmanical cord.
E.
तन्तु, and पर्व्वन् a festival.

m. (-भः)
1 Mustard seed, (Sinapis dichotoma); also sometimes तन्तुका.
2 A calf.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and भा to shine, affix क.

n. (-रं)
See the next.

n. (-लं)
The filaments or fibrous root of the lotus.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and ल what has; also with र, तन्तुर.

m. (-पः)
1 A weaver.
2 A loom.
E.
तन्तु a thread, वप to weave, affix घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 A weaver.
2 A spider.
E.
तन्तु a thread, वे to weave, अण् affix; also तन्त्रवाय.

f. (-हा)
The banana or plantain.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and विग्रह a part.

f. (-ला)
A weaver's shop.
E.
तन्तु weaving, and शाला a house or hall.

n. (-तं)
Wove cloth.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and सन्तत collected.

m. (-रः)
The betel-nut^1 tree; also तन्तुसारक.
E.
तन्तु a thread, and सार pith; having a stringy pith.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (न्त्रः-न्त्रा-न्त्रं)
Dependant, subservient.
m. (-न्त्रः)
A weaver.
f. (-न्त्री)
1 Any string or rope.
2 The wire or string of a lute.
3 Any tubular vessel of the body.
4 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum): see गूडुची.
5 The name of a river.
6 A young woman.
n. (-न्त्रं)
1 A Tantra, a religious treatise teaching peculiar and mystical formulæ and rites for the worship of the deities, or the attainment of superhuman power: it is mostly in the form of a dialogue between ŚIVA and DURGĀ, who are the peculiar gods of the Tāntrikas: there is a great number of these works, and their authority, in many parts of India, seems to have, in a great measure, superseded that of the Vedas: according to one account, a Tantra comprises five subjects, the creation and destruction of the world, the worship of the gods, the attainment of all objects, magical rites for the acquirement of six (superhuman) faculties, and four modes of union with spirit by meditation; a variety of subjects are, however, introduced into many of them, whilst some are limited to a single topic, as the mode of breathing in certain rites, the language of birds, beasts, &c.
2 A branch of the Vedas, that which teaches Mantras or mystical and magical formula.
3 Demonstration, clear and right conclusion.
4 Raiment, vesture.
5 A medicament, a drug.
6 A principal medicament, or perhaps a charm, considered as producing medicinal effects.
7 Providing for a family.
8 A cause, a motive.
9 Cause common to two or more results; the instruments or means of more than one effect.
10 Necessary or indispensable act or provision; the right way of doing any thing.
11 Chief, principal.
12 A royal retinue, a court, a train.
13 An army.
14 A royal property; that of providing for the security and prosperity of the kingdom.
15 A realm, a country.
16 A thread.
17 Subservience, service, dependance.
18 Oath or ordeal.
19 Decorations, hanging with trophies, garlands, &c.
20 Heap, multitude.
21

Wealth.
22

A house.
23 An implement of weaving, a loom.
24 Happiness, felicity.
E.
तन to spread or extend, affix ष्ट्रन्; or तत्रि to spread, to support a family, &c. affix क, fem. affix ङीप्; or तत्त्र with ई Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्त्रः-न्त्री-न्त्रं)
1 Stringed, having wires or strings, (as a musical instrument.)
2 Relating to the Tantras, &c.
E.
तन्त्र, and अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
New and unbleached cloth.
E.
तन्त्र the loom, and कन् affix, recently from the loom.

n. (-ष्ठं)
A fibrous stick for cleaning the woof, &c.
E.
तन्त्र weaving, and काष्ठ wood.

f. (-ता)
1 Dependance, subservience.
2 The quality or character of a

Tantra.
3

Comprehending several rites in one, performance of one ceremony or penance in lieu of a number.
E.
तत्त्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, तन्त्रत्व.

m. (-पः)
A weaver.
mn. (-पः-पं)
A loom.
E.
तन्त्र a thread, and वप to weave, affix घञ्.

m. (-यः)
1 A weaver.
2 A spider.
E.
तन्त्र a thread, a web, and वे to spin or weave, affix घञ्; also तन्त्रवाप, and sometimes तन्द्रवाय.

f. (-का)
A plant, Guricha.
E.
कन् added to तन्त्री.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Relating to the Tāntras, taught by them, following them, &c.
2 Relating to a thread, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A scholar, a man completely versed in any science.
2 A follower of the doctrine taught by the Tantras.
E.
तन्त्र truth, &c. and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि)
1 Spun, wove, made of threads.
2 Chorded, having chords or wires, (as an instrument.)
3 A musician.
4 Having a Tantra, following one, &c.
E.
तन्त्र, and इनि aff.

m. (-कः)
A name of JAYADRATHA.
E.
तन्त्रि (derived from तन्त्र any army, with इनि affix,) a general, and पालक who cherishes or aids.

m. (-यः)
A weaver: see तन्त्रवाय.

f. (-न्द्रा)
1 Lassitude, exhaustion, weariness, syncope.
2 Sleepiness, sluggishness.
E.
तन्द्रि a Sautra root, to be weary, affixes क and टाप्; also with क्तिन् affix तन्द्रि. f. (-न्द्रिः) and with ङीष् added तन्द्री.

mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु)
Slothful, sluggish, overcome with sleep or fatigue.
E.
तन्द्र sloth, and आलुच् aff.

Sleepiness.
2

Lassitude.
3

Fainting, exhaustion: see तन्द्रा.
E.
as above, or तदि Sautra root, to be weary, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.

Drowsiness.
2
Lassitude: see तन्द्रा.

f. (-का)
Sloth, sleepiness.
E.
कन् added to तन्द्री.

f. (-न्निः)
A plant: see चक्रकुल्या.

n. sub. (-त्रं)
The archetype or subtile rudiment of elementary matter.
adv.
Merely that.
E.
तद्, and मात्र only, or element.

Night.
2

A musical instrument.
E.
तन to spread, यतुच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्वत्-न्वन्ती-न्वत्)
Spreading, extending.
E.
तन to spread, शतृ aff.

n. (-वं)
Thinness, spareness.
E.
तनु, and अण् aff.

m. (-रः)
A whirlpool.
E.
तन to spread, ऊरच् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Wearied, fatigued, distressed.
2 Languid, languishing.
3 Faded, withered, blighted.
E.
तम to be distressed, affix क्त.

m. (-वं)
Spinning, weaving.
E.
तन्तु a thread, अण aff.

m. (-नः)
Wind.
